test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who has been the chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) since 5 April, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Manoj Soni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Manoj Soni, **who was appointed as the** chairman of UPSC on 5 April, 2022**. 
 
• He is a former Vice Chancellor of Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Open University and has also served as a member of the Gujarat Public Service Commission.
 
• Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is a constitutional body responsible for conducting civil services examinations and selecting candidates for various government posts.
 
• Dr. T.C.A. Anant was the former Chief Statistician of India and served as the chairman of UPSC from January 2020 to April 2022.
 
• Shri Bharat Bhushan Vyas is a retired IAS officer who served as the Chief Secretary of Jammu and Kashmir and was appointed as a member of UPSC in June 2021.
 
• Ms. Smita Nagaraj is a former IAS officer who served as the Deputy Director in the Prime Minister's Office and was appointed as a member of UPSC in December 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A constitutional authority in India, the Union Public Service Commission appoints officers to several services within the Government of India and directly recruits officers to the All India Services and the Central Civil Services (Group A and B) through examinations.
 
• The Department of Personnel and Training is in charge of managing the staff.
 
• The agency's charter is authorized by Services Under the Union and the States, Part XIV of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Constitution requires the commission to be consulted while making appointments to the Union and All India Services.
